contentSummary: This is the group's environmental-compliance sales page, aimed squarely at cash buyers, flag states and auditors who need to see HKC / ISO 14001 / Basel Convention language before they place a vessel. The body runs three sections: an eight-card icon grid of environmental commitments (sustainability, eco-friendly recycling, pollution control, hazardous waste disposal, international compliance, biodiversity, monitoring/audits, community engagement), a mid-page "Our Companies" panel naming the two operating entities plus a contact card for Mr. Devang Gujarati, and a second eight-item grid on Waste Management covering segregation, hazardous handling, 90%+ recycling, pollution prevention,…
